1.web: When Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.
1.asv: And it came to pass, when Samuel was old, that he made his sons judges over Israel.

2.web: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel; and the name of his second, Abijah: they were judges in Beersheba.
2.asv: Now the name of his first-born was Joel; and the name of his second, Abijah: they were judges in Beer-sheba.

3.web: His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned aside after lucre, and took bribes, and perverted justice.
3.asv: And his sons walked not in his ways, but turned aside after lucre, and took bribes, and perverted justice.

4.web: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together, and came to Samuel to Ramah;
4.asv: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together, and came to Samuel unto Ramah;

5.web: and they said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways: now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.”
5.asv: and they said unto him, Behold, thou art old, and thy sons walk not in thy ways: now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.

6.web: But the thing displeased Samuel, when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to Yahweh.
6.asv: But the thing displeased Samuel, when they said, Give us a king to judge us. And Samuel prayed unto Jehovah.

7.web: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me, that I should not be king over them.
7.asv: And Jehovah said unto Samuel, Hearken unto the voice of the people in all that they say unto thee; for they have not rejected thee, but they have rejected me, that I should not be king over them.

8.web: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me, and served other gods, so do they also to you.
8.asv: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even unto this day, in that they have forsaken me, and served other gods, so do they also unto thee.

9.web: Now therefore listen to their voice: however you shall protest solemnly to them, and shall show them the way of the king who shall reign over them.”
9.asv: Now therefore hearken unto their voice: howbeit thou shalt protest solemnly unto them, and shalt show them the manner of the king that shall reign over them.

10.web: Samuel told all Yahweh’s words to the people who asked of him a king.
10.asv: And Samuel told all the words of Jehovah unto the people that asked of him a king.

11.web: He said, “This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons, and appoint them to him, for his chariots, and to be his horsemen; and they shall run before his chariots;
11.asv: And he said, This will be the manner of the king that shall reign over you: he will take your sons, and appoint them unto him, for his chariots, and to be his horsemen; and they shall run before his chariots;

12.web: and he will appoint them to him for captains of thousands, and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his ground, and to reap his harvest, and to make his instruments of war, and the instruments of his chariots.
12.asv: and he will appoint them unto him for captains of thousands, and captains of fifties; and he will set some to plow his ground, and to reap his harvest, and to make his instruments of war, and the instruments of his chariots.

13.web: He will take your daughters to be perfumers, and to be cooks, and to be bakers.
13.asv: And he will take your daughters to be perfumers, and to be cooks, and to be bakers.

14.web: He will take your fields, and your vineyards, and your olive groves, even their best, and give them to his servants.
14.asv: And he will take your fields, and your vineyards, and your oliveyards, even the best of them, and give them to his servants.

15.web: He will take the tenth of your seed, and of your vineyards, and give to his officers, and to his servants.
15.asv: And he will take the tenth of your seed, and of your vineyards, and give to his officers, and to his servants.

16.web: He will take your male servants, and your female servants, and your best young men, and your donkeys, and put them to his work.
16.asv: And he will take your men-servants, and your maid-servants, and your goodliest young men, and your asses, and put them to his work.

17.web: He will take the tenth of your flocks: and you shall be his servants.
17.asv: He will take the tenth of your flocks: and ye shall be his servants.

18.web: You shall cry out in that day because of your king whom you shall have chosen you; and Yahweh will not answer you in that day.”
18.asv: And ye shall cry out in that day because of your king whom ye shall have chosen you; and Jehovah will not answer you in that day.

19.web: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No; but we will have a king over us,
19.asv: But the people refused to hearken unto the voice of Samuel; and they said, Nay: but we will have a king over us,

20.web: that we also may be like all the nations, and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.”
20.asv: that we also may be like all the nations, and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.

21.web: Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of Yahweh.
21.asv: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of Jehovah.

22.web: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Listen to their voice, and make them a king.” Samuel said to the men of Israel, “Every man go to his city.”
22.asv: And Jehovah said to Samuel, Hearken unto their voice, and make them a king. And Samuel said unto the men of Israel, Go ye every man unto his city.
